name: PLATINUM MAIN
note: owner 2 Nov: very shiny chrome platinum. NAV-04 repeats (orchid), TXT-103 repeats (cyan, copper); BTN-105, CRD-119, SCR-104, HOV-104, CRD-129 are new.

effects.name: Elevator Floors
effects.where: THE TOUR menu: a floor readout (FLOOR 33 down to G) sits in the top bar and counts as you go deeper; THE TOUR opens the brushed-metal panel whose doors slide apart to show a round floor button for each of the 8 stops

effects.name: Convex Lens
effects.where: Main sign-up buttons: CLAIM YOUR FOUNDING TICKET (hero) and SEND MY SHORTLIST (four questions). A lens-shaped see-through button, platinum edge, a spot of light that follows the pointer and a label that swells

effects.name: Glass Slab
effects.where: Text-alerts card (FIRST WORD, BY TEXT): a thick pane of see-through glass whose platinum edge shows as it tilts, with a thin band of light drifting across it

effects.name: Counter Columns
effects.where: HOW WE CHOOSE: the six steps are tiles in three columns that slide past each other in opposite directions as you scroll, around the see-through HOW WE CHOOSE plate

effects.name: Tide Fill
effects.where: The two big reading statements (BEFORE YOU BUY ANYTHING, THE PEPTICITY PROMISE): every word is outlined, then fills white from the bottom like liquid mercury as you scroll; key phrases fill with a platinum mirror, a glint that travels word to word, and an underline

effects.name: Lead Trail
effects.where: Moving the pointer over any glass card, the menu or a button leaves a trail of small see-through tour-stop cards that pop up and drift away (mouse only; off for touch and reduced motion)

effects.name: Viewfinder
effects.where: BRING A FRIEND IN card (refer a friend): framed like a camera viewfinder: corner brackets close in on hover, a focus box follows the pointer, a small light leaks round the edge, a blinking record dot by SHARE PEPTICITY
